title: 2. Big & Bold
slide_intent: Use scale and detail deliberately so viewers notice the product quickly and read confidence in its presentation.
strategic_value: An oversized burger and rich orange field can make Burger King’s food visually assertive.
demonstration: Cream heading and explanatory copy sit at left; a macro burger photograph fills the right with a shadow below.
practical_value: Judge whether cropping preserves appetizing detail while making the product dominant.

content_islands.name: Principle copy
content_islands.spec: Place the cream heading and statements about scale and rich color at left.

content_islands.name: Macro food
content_islands.spec: Place the large burger at right, cropped along the outer edge with its shadow on the field.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy describes confidence and directness as the reason for macro photography and detail.
reference_purposes.Application: The page explicitly calls for playing with scale and macro photography, demonstrated by the enlarged burger.

ingredient.name: Macro food photography
ingredient.role: Give the food confident visual presence.
ingredient.application: Play with scale, emphasize details and use full, rich colors.
ingredient.scope: Design principle in this historical guide; the sample does not set a mandatory product-to-page ratio.
